prompt: ONE original tall portrait 1290:2796 wallpaper for Glaze COPPER SELVEDGE. Physical handwoven METAL TEXTILE relief, photographed flat from above with low raking light: extraordinarily thin strips of warm annealed copper woven over-under with oxidised turquoise metal filaments, raised and buckled into an impossible topographic world. The bottom half shows a diagonal tectonic fold where an aquamarine woven river turns vertically upward and frays into hanging copper warp ends, while two burnished sheet ridges fold through each other like a loose tapestry; all terrain is clearly made from intersecting ribbon warp and weft, hammered narrow strip edges, cut fringe, tiny tool scratches, local verdigris. Precise material fidelity, slight handmade irregularity, museum textile photography, tactile shallow bas-relief rather than 3D fantasy rendering. Ground is continuous very dark green-black #102925 woven metal; upper 43 percent is quiet low-contrast crossweave with generous empty space for phone icons, details accumulate low in frame. Palette rich copper #CE8657, oxidised turquoise #65BAA9, blackened green #102925, pale warm ivory accents #F5EBDD. Asymmetrical, polished, unusual woven landscape world, no animals, stationery, household objects, tools, text, numerals, lettering, logos, phone mockup, border, UI, clock, date or live values. One continuous wallpaper, no collage.
